destination.travelNote: Sajek is in Rangamati district but is reached from Khagrachhari. Vehicles travel the 70 km hill road in escorted groups; ask in Khagrachhari for the day's times. The clouds are best from June to November. Check road and security news before you go, because the area sometimes closes to tourists.
destination.hotelNote: Most rooms are in Ruilui Para. Book ahead for Fridays and holidays.
